newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Daesung plans rights issue.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Daesung plans rights issue.

text.p: South Korea's Daesung Electric Wire Co Ltd plans to offer a 28-for-100 rights issue from March 31 to April 1, a company statement said on Saturday.
It said the issue would be made at a 25 percent discount to the base issue price per share. The base issue price will be announced later.
The company plans to issue 480,598 new common shares and allocate 20 percent of them to employees. The remainder will be offered to shareholders registered as of February 28, the statement said.
The issue would raise the company's paid-in capital to 9.5 billion won from 7.1 billion, it said.
Subscription is set for March 31 and April 1, with payment due on April 14.
Daesung Electric Wire's shares closed Saturday's trading at 66,100 won per share, down 900 won on the day.
